topics.label: Type 2 diabetes
topics.description: A common condition influenced by many genes and strongly by weight, activity and diet. Single common variants shift odds modestly.

topics.label: Venous thromboembolism (blood clots)
topics.description: Clots in deep veins or lungs. Population association studies; see the clinical section for ClinVar interpretations of the same variants.

topics.label: Alzheimer disease
topics.description: Sensitive: many people prefer not to learn APOE results. Hidden unless you choose to show it.

topics.label: LDL cholesterol
topics.description: Blood level of LDL cholesterol. Measured directly by a routine lipid panel, which is far more informative than genotype.

topics.label: Iron status
topics.traitPattern: ^(serum iron amount|transferrin saturation measurement|iron biomarker measurement)$
topics.description: Blood markers of iron (serum iron, transferrin saturation). Measured directly by an iron panel.

topics.label: Homocysteine level
topics.description: Blood homocysteine, which depends heavily on folate, B12 and kidney function.

topics.label: Body mass index
topics.description: Weight relative to height. Each common variant has a very small average effect.

topics.label: Alcohol intake and metabolism
topics.description: Variants in alcohol-metabolising enzymes associated with how much people drink. Effects are ancestry-specific (rs671 is common mainly in East Asian populations).

topics.label: Vitamin D level
topics.description: Blood 25-hydroxyvitamin D. A blood test measures this directly.

topics.label: Coffee / caffeine intake
topics.description: Associations with habitual coffee or caffeine consumption.

topics.label: Lactase persistence
topics.description: Whether the lactase enzyme stays active into adulthood. See the ClinVar interpretation of this site.

topics.label: Athletic performance
topics.description: Consumer tests often market these variants for training advice. Only genome-wide significant human associations are shown.
